execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a future MSWI tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries that tranche through implementation, required validation, verified closeout, and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, history, benchmark and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation, and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If the selected tranche cannot credibly leave the closeout reserve intact, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the tranche.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MSWI is the cross-domain consequence orchestration and persistent-world-response family; it does not become a second World, Environment, Character, Creature, Vehicle, Base, Project, Economy, Organization, Religion, Culture, Action/Event or content-definition ledger
MSWI starts from committed owner Events/changes or explicit previews, builds typed consequence candidates, and requires every target owner to validate and commit its own mutation

DPL remains authoritative for profession activities, enterprise/staffing/growth, arts/performance, cybernetics/symbiotes/biotech and life-simulation foundations; MSWI consumes accepted Events and routes systemic consequences rather than implementing parallel life-loop or performance runtimes

MNCS retains NPC/creature generation, ecology/habitat/lifecycle/population-generation and ecology authoring; MSWI-04 consumes accepted ecology/population definitions and Packet-06 resolution semantics without creating a second creature simulator

GPR retains reusable gameplay-pattern execution and loop composition, including specialist vehicle/sports/social/timing modules; MSWI does not implement a separate pursuit, profession-loop, performance or grand-Project gameplay engine
APW/D26 Project/Time remains canonical for grand/world Projects, contribution/time progression and milestones; MSWI-03 consumes accepted milestone Events and routes downstream consequences

Religion/Culture/Organization owners retain reusable and live doctrine/ideology/obligation truth; Packet-01/MRCS/GPR own reusable social/norm definitions and execution; MSWI only consumes accepted doctrine/social Events for systemic fan-out

MERA retains engineering/refit/assembly authority and MBES retains built-environment, infrastructure, utilities, logistics, production, settlement and reactive-development hooks; MSWI consumes accepted outputs for persistent consequences
MSLR retains non-standard spatial-law runtime authority under its effective PDCP-reduced strict order; MSWI consumes typed MSLR spatial Events/deltas instead of creating another spatial runtime
MCS retains map/cartographic geometry authority, MAS retains Adventure/Scene/site assembly authority, MCCS retains entity presentation authority and MSAS/AAI retain audio authoring/playback authority
PCA-02/PCA-03 retain generic procedural recipe/DAG/seed/cache infrastructure; surviving MSWI-14 implements only systemic candidate/variant/promotion adapters
PCA-12 and PDCP Packet 08 retain generic simulation/formal-analysis machinery; surviving MSWI-18 implements only MSWI graph interpretation, coverage diagnostics and final proof
PDCP Packet 07 shared preview/dry-run/explanation/diagnostic/intervention/recovery semantics are reused; MSWI does not create a parallel generic GM/debug framework

persistent world transformation always records exact source, scope, timing, affected owner domains, reversibility/recovery class and provenance; a visible presentation change is not itself canonical world mutation
consequence route applicability never grants target-domain permission or bypasses target-owner validation
automatic fan-out is bounded by explicit route depth, deduplication and cycle rules; no unbounded reaction cascade is implied by systemic connectivity
ecology runtime uses exact/range/band/distribution/unknown quantity semantics honestly and never fabricates exact individuals or universal ecological equations
composite entities preserve one stable identity while binding governed roles; role binding never duplicates owner truth

biological component/harvest/modification integration uses accepted source-authored anatomy, condition, compatibility and lineage rules; absent organs, yields, donor effects or psychological consequences remain unresolved
procedural site/scenario output remains ephemeral or proposed until GM/owner-authorized promotion; stable canonical place identity is preserved across current/historical/alternate variants
transformation Campaign templates configure accepted MSWI primitives and MRCS-authored definitions; they do not fork the runtime or create genre authority
systemic coverage diagnostics report declared routes, fan-out, loops, dead links and missing integrations without inventing mechanics to improve a score
permission filtering occurs before route counts, search, diagnostics, AI context and export; hidden routes or populations cannot leak through aggregate metadata
optional AI may recommend routes, consequences, missing links, variants and tests but cannot silently mutate owner state, promote generated sites or commit systemic consequences
meaningful state change and diagnostics expose accessible text/semantic equivalents rather than depending only on color, animation, audio, maps or graph visuals

proprietary benchmark products remain clean-room planning provenance only; protected code, formulas, authored content, UI expression, assets, music, maps, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking MSWI workflows
no MSWI implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific surviving MSWI work item
